About the Project

Enhancing Farmer Livelihood

Project Overview

Abstract

The project addresses high input costs, soil degradation, and low farmer income. It promotes precision farming tools combined with organic practices, delivering improved soil health, reduced costs, higher yields, and enhanced livelihoods.

AI-Powered Recommendations

⚠️ High Priority - Field B Irrigation

Soil moisture at 48% (below 55% threshold). Activate irrigation for 200L to reach optimal 65%. This will prevent yield loss and maintain the 3.2T/acre target.

ℹ️ Medium Priority - Temperature Forecast

Temperature forecast shows 35°C tomorrow. Deploy shade cloth for 6-8 hours to maintain current 28.5°C average and protect crop quality.

✓ Low Priority - Soil Nutrients

Organic matter at healthy 4.2%. Nitrogen levels adequate for next 5 days. Continue current regimen to maintain 85% soil health score.
